HRA Analysis: MOSTERT (10) is having his first start in Australia for the stable of Chantal Turpin and hasn’t trialled. He looked to be quite smart in NZ and was impressive in his latest win when burning around to the lead mid race before dashing up a nice last quarter to score. FIFTY THREE STARS (2) has been unstoppable since joining the stable of Ron Sallis winning four of his five starts and remains undefeated at Albion Park since joining the new stable. He should be close enough in the run and should run well again. GREAT ACHIEVER (1) has an ideal draw in this race and has been good since joining his new stable. He secured a good run last time out and was running on strongly into second behind Buddy Perfect at Redcliffe. GREATGREAT BOULDER (4) burned across to the lead two starts ago and was just run down late in good time by Hes All Torque. He should be able to settle close enough again in this race and looks a good hope in this race. SELECTIONS: MOSTERT (10), FIFTY THREE STARS (2), GREAT ACHIEVER (1), GREATGREAT BOULDER (4) SUGGESTED BET: MOSTERT (10) to win.

SWEET ROCKY (5) appears to bring quite strong NSW form into this race and lands in a stable which has had very good success with horses first up in the stable. He appears to have some gate speed and if he was able to work to the lead he would likely be hard to beat. LLANFAIR LLEWELLAN (10) scored an impressive win last time out when sitting without cover rating good time beating Next To Me at this track. He finds another suitable race and his last start outing suggested he was close to his best. STUDLEIGH MARK (9) took on a strong race last time out over the 2138 and wasn’t beaten too far there in fifth behind Mister Manager. He may appreciate the step back to the 1660 and can be running on again. OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (4) took on a race last time out where the first three home were all on the pegs up on speed. She should get a good run off the speed this time and will just be hoping the race is run to suit. SELECTIONS: SWEET ROCKY (5), LLANFAIR LLEWELLAN (10), STUDLEIGH MARK (9), OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (4) SUGGESTED BET: SWEET ROCKY (5) to win.

MISS BAY KING COLE (3) has gate speed and appears to find a race where she might be able to work across to the lead in the early stages. She scored a nice win last time out in good time at this track when running down Bracken Warrior off his back. PRINCESS OF SAVOY (8) trialled up nicely recently at this track finishing alongside Betterthanfederer having given that horse a start in the run. She draws to do no work in this race and should be running on strongly. DOLLY ROCKET (7) draws poorly in this race as a result of her ODM tag. She got back last time out and was running on strongly there into fourth behind Racana. She will need the race run to suit but is going well enough. HARPERVILLE (9) hasn’t raced since July which does appear a query in this race. She should get a good run through early and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: MISS BAY KING COLE (3), PRINCESS OF SAVOY (8), DOLLY ROCKET (7), HARPERVILLE (9) SUGGESTED BET: MISS BAY KING COLE (3) to win.

DOUGS FLAME (7) has been in terrific form scoring two impressive wins two and three starts ago before being completely luckless last time out when finishing 2.3m from the winner Isla Rochelle. Despite the draw she looks to have strong claims again. RACE FOR RICHES (3) has been racing well recently and ran another good race last time out finishing third behind stablemate Fate Awaits in fast time. He doesn’t have brilliant gate speed but should settle close enough and can run well again. WILLIAMS (8) draws to have options in this race whether he follows through early and is driven for luck or looks to come off into the running line. He worked hard to hold out Fate Awaits last start but just found him too classy and was good enough to battle away for second. GEM PUNTER PETE (2) has gate speed and may look to press forward early and find a prominent position. His latest win came when leading all the way at this track beating Dragon who has since won multiple times. SELECTIONS: DOUGS FLAME (7), RACE FOR RICHES (3), WILLIAMS (8), GEM PUNTER PETE (2) SUGGESTED BET: DOUGS FLAME (7) to win.

GOLDEN SHOOZ (1) has some gate speed without being brilliant off the gate. She drew poorly last time out and got a long way back in a race taken out by Hes All Torque who was able to complete a hat-trick of wins on Wednesday. She should go close. MAYWYN TROUBADOUR (8) appears likely to get a good run through in the early stages of this race. He has little luck when forced to the rear of the field last time out before cutting back to the inside and making up good ground into fourth. MARTIN MAGIC (3) hasn’t been driven off the gate in recent outings having drawn wide in slightly less suitable races. He may look to use his brilliant gate speed to get across early and will have options from there. LOCH LAMOND (7) sat close to the speed last time out at Albion Park in a race taken out in fast time by QLD newcomer Our Rocky. He has been racing in good enough form for a race of this nature but will need some luck from the draw. SELECTIONS: GOLDEN SHOOZ (1), MAYWYN TROUBADOUR (8), MARTIN MAGIC (3), LOCH LAMOND (7) SUGGESTED BET: MARTIN MAGIC (3) to win.

GOLDEN FIRE (7) is a mare with brilliant gate speed and showed that yet again last time out when firing across before making a break which took her out of play there. If she can launch across and lead in this race before taking a sit she is going to be very dangerous late. SALLY BIGTIME (5) was somewhat fortuitously able to find the top early last time out after Golden Fire led early before making a break which checked one of the other key fancies in the race Tremendous Sensation. She looks some chance of being able to work to the top again in this race and would run a good race from there if she found that position. ISLA ROCHELLE (2) flew home late to score an impressive win last time out at this track and trip beating Mossdale Terry and Path To Greatness. She has gate speed and may look to find a more forward position in this race. SHEZA BONNY SHEILA (1) secured a good run on the pegs last time out and was able to run into fourth late in a race which became a dash to the line. She should secure a good run on the pegs again and looks a good top four chance. SELECTIONS: GOLDEN FIRE (7), SALLY BIGTIME (5), ISLA ROCHELLE (2), SHEZA BONNY SHEILA (1) SUGGESTED BET: GOLDEN FIRE (7) to win.

SEASIDE GLORY (3) took on a stronger race last time out won by 2025 Rising Sun winner Fate Awaits where she got back on the pegs and was held up at a crucial stage. This looks much easier stepping back to racing the mares. SWEET DIOR (7) draws widest in this race which looks a touch awkward on paper. She was able to lead last time out taking them all the way rating good time. If she can find a prominent position in this race she should run well. BUBBY TO BASE (1) has very good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead. She led and may have just got a bit tired late having set a strong early tempo in that race. With a more economical run she can bounce back. RACANA (2) was able to lead last time out and proved too good there leading all the way. She has always been a horse with an abundance of ability and really seems to be putting it all together this campaign. SELECTIONS: SEASIDE GLORY (3), SWEET DIOR (7), BUBBY TO BASE (1), RACANA (2) SUGGESTED BET: SEASIDE GLORY (3) to win.

ATTACHMENT (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. He has been in excellent form completing the hat-trick of wins last start and can look to make it four in a row in this race in what looks a very winnable contest. TIMS A TROOPER (2) should be able to duck in behind the leader in this race. He put in a big run last time out getting right back in the run before flashing into third in a race which wasn’t run to suit at all. If he’s leaders back he looks a near certain top two chance and has some winning claims. WISPER A SECRET (3) was able to launch across at the start last time out before taking the sit on stablemate Attachment before running a good third behind that horse. He draws well in the small field and should be close enough. DARIN (5) scored an impressive win two starts ago when taking the sit on French Fries and sprinting past him late. He draws less favourably this time but does look to have strong claims for the minor money in this race. SELECTIONS: ATTACHMENT (1), TIMS A TROOPER (2), WISPER A SECRET (3), DARIN (5) SUGGESTED BET: ATTACHMENT (1) to win.

FATE AWAITS (1) was forced to do the work outside the leader last time out and just proved too good there when winning nicely beating Williams. He should be able to lead this time and should be very hard to beat out in front in this field. FREE THINKER (2) in a small field without a back row he appears likely to have the option to drop in behind the leader in this race from a good draw. His latest placing came at this track and trip when getting a similar run to the one he is likely to get in this race behind Heza Punk Rocker. AIR EXPRESS (4) raced on the pegs last time out and battled on just fairly there finishing fourth in a race taken out by Rakasandy. He should settle close enough to the speed in this race and should be thereabouts the minor money. MIRACLE MOOSE (3) was left to race off the pegs last time out on a very hot tempo in a race taken out by Rakasandy in fast time. He should secure a more economical run this time and could be suited by what looks to be a slowly run race which could favour runners on the pegs. SELECTIONS: FATE AWAITS (1), FREE THINKER (2), AIR EXPRESS (4), MIRACLE MOOSE (3) SUGGESTED BET: FREE THINKER (2) to place. TOMMY MACH (5) ran on well when clear over the concluding stages last start has sound claims. PARADIGM (4) form is sound in similar grade and should be handy. STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (6) recent form sees him with a genuine chance to make it 2 wins from last 3 starts. NIGHT SPIRIT (7) is having first start for the Pullicino stable and is drawn to get a cheap run.

JILLIBY BLISS (7) racing very consistent since joining the Girardi stable and looks the one to beat. EAGLESTONE (2) is working up to a win and won’t be far away. ALDEBARAN BREE (5) improving with racing and has place claims. MAGICAL MADGE (4) looks the best of the rest on exposed form however keep a watch on markets for first starter REHAB LAD and newcomer to the Weidenbach stable EMILY MEAGAN.

This looks a drop in class for CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (5). MEET ME AT THE BEAH NZ (6) continues to race consistently and has claims despite the wide draw. MY ULTIMATE HENRY (7) should get a good trip behind GIANT JACKSON and expect be thereabouts at the finish. LOCHINVAR RULER (2) should be prominent over the short trip.

THE GOLDEN HOOK(4) was a strong effort to win last start, looks well placed and will be hard to beat here. KEAYANG MEMORY (8) solid form and looks one of the main chances. ALWAYS ON SAFARI (7) has place claims from a tricky draw. If OAKLANDER (1) can make use of the good draw it should run a forward race.

QUARTARARO (10) talented trotter when it does everything right. TINEY (8) racing well and has solid eachway claims. NOTHING I WANT (2) resumes here and expect a forward showing. PARLEZVOUS PATTY (9) will need some luck from the draw but has claims.

MACHFREDDY (1) sound effort when resuming for the Ryan stable, drawn to be prominent and should go close. LUNADIVA (6) has claims despite the wide draw. NOHASHTAGREQUIRED (5) first starter from the Bain stable may pay to keep safe. SIENNA BELLA (9) racing well however is awkwardly drawn here.

FE FE ON FIRE (5) strong effort when second at first run for the Hryhorec stable and has solid claims to go one better here. HASTY BID (2) racing well and from the draw has appeal. ALORA (3) resuming from spell and if near its best form has eachway claims. ZANY GIRL (7) awkwardly drawn with place claims.

SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (10) form before spell looked good for a race like this, awkward draw but should be hard to beat. NO GOOD REASON (1) drawn to be prominent for a long way. LAZIEST (6) will find this easier than recent runs, has solid claims. MURRA LANE (3) and IMA TIGGY TIGER are place chances. LISTEN TO THE HAND would be hard to beat if it gains a start.

A tricky race with many chances. TAKE MY WALLET NZ (2) not far away last start and drawn well here. JACKIE DANIELS (4) having first start for Hryhorec stable hasn’t won for nearly 2 years but has been racing in stronger Gloucester Park company, keep safe. RESURRECTS (9) has changed stables now in the HILL team, watch for betting moves. BALLADORO (10) awkwardly drawn and not had a lot of luck recently, place claims. OVERVIEW:KYVALLEY REEVA (3) hadn’t done much of note prior to last start, but her performance in winning her maiden was hard to ignore. John Caldow jumped aboard, pushed her forward to lead and she continued to extend, putting a gap on the opposition and winning with something in hand in solid closing sectionals. She had been unruly prior to that, so proceed with caution, but a repeat will see her hard to beat. THE PASO DOBLE (6) broke through for a terrific and deserved maiden victory last time out, showing his customary early gate speed and putting a space on his rivals. Even though he’s drawn wide, his gate manners can negate that, allowing him to look for a forward position and take running down again. RIPPING RONALDO (4) creates interest first-up from a break considering he went out on a high with a solid win at Maryborough in July. No trial into this, but this is an astute stable, so monitor betting. WHISKEY DAWN (7) will appreciate this level compared to her last two starts in stronger company, where she wasn’t too far off the winners. She’s yet to place since her maiden victory at this track, but is going okay. The draw just means she will have to work at some stage. JINXED (2) is a 3yo filly having her second start and showed good speed for a sound fourth on debut last week. She can run well again based on that performance. BACK: KYVALLEY REEVA (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:KYVALLEY REEVA (3), THE PASO DOBLE (6), RIPPING RONALDO (4), WHISKEY DAWN (7)

OVERVIEW:WAR ZONE (10) was held up at a vital stage last week and may have gone close to winning had he seen daylight a little earlier, and they ran decent time for this grade. He was a winner three starts back, again in good time, when able to lead. Although the draw and map do him no favours, he can sweep home with the right tempo. JUSTLIKEDAVE (7) is a horse who never seems to have much luck with barrier draws and, as a result, is often turning in nice runs from difficult positions. He gets no favours again, but this doesn’t look as strong as what he’s been opposed to. TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6) loomed up and was disappointing in the straight last time, and that was coming off a decent win at Shepparton. Herbertson will no doubt give him every chance to improve, so keep him safe. PICKLE IT (5) was disappointing last week, but that was a slightly harder race. He does run his best races when able to find the front, so he may be open to improvement. The chances don’t end there, with a case able to be made for most in the race, headed by MIKI MARK (4) and POWERLINC (3), who also go in the Early Quaddie. SELECTIONS:WAR ZONE (10), JUSTLIKEDAVE (7), TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6), PICKLE IT (5)

OVERVIEW: Incredibly challenging race and hard to be confident. BETTA THAN LOVE (3) has been well supported in his two runs since returning to Victoria. He had his chance two starts back when second, then tried to lead last time but was under pressure a lap out and was beaten by a space. The stewards’ report had enough detail to suggest there may have been excuses, and he could bounce back off that effort. Monitor betting for any added confidence. HOME AND DRY (9) hasn’t won since March, when he was able to lead, but you can make a case that this race looks to be his most suitable in some time. The form of this field suggests they are unlikely to be running fast times, which might be more comfortable for his sweet spot. He has a soft trailing draw to conserve and come with one run. CHASING THE WIND (4) worked mid-race here last week and was sound to the line in a slogging affair. He hasn’t won in well over a year, but Alford jumps on again, so he’s worth considering. DELTA STARZ (6) was a winner two starts back, although the form out of that race hasn’t necessarily stacked up. He has an in-form driver, which helps. I had ROCKROLL RAMBO (7) on top from the same draw last week and he was never a factor, working home fairly. He will likely be map-negative again, so has place claims, similar to REASON TO LAUGH (10), who will need the right tempo. SELECTIONS:BETTA THAN LOVE (3), HOME AND DRY (9), CHASING THE WIND (4), DELTA STARZ (6)

OVERVIEW:ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (3) is returning to more suitable grade after performing well in the VICBRED Series, where she ran home well without much luck in the final. There’s a form reference from Maryborough four starts back, where she was able to lead and was run down on the post by MONTANA PRIDE (4), who she meets here with a better draw. The stable is worth respecting as infrequent visitors to Cranbourne. MONTANA PRIDE (4) is racing very well, and his three runs at Melton since the race where they met have all been very good, with not much going his way on each occasion. He’s the testing material. KOSIMO (9) seems well suited with his claiming price dropping him significantly in class. Although he was poor last time, his runs haven’t been too bad at Melton and he was a winner there in May in much tougher grade. UBETTA KNOT (1) has been a little costly her past couple, but she has either had to work or had a tricky draw, and gets a much easier map this time. If they overcook things in front, she should get her chance along the sprint lane. PLATINUM JIVE (5) is a very nice mare who’s been freshened for this off a trial win at Bacchus Marsh. She has a very good record at this track and can sprint well off a helmet. She just has a sticky draw and will need the right tempo. SELECTIONS:ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (3), MONTANA PRIDE (4), KOSIMO (9), UBETTA KNOT (1)

OVERVIEW: MASTER LOUEY (5) was found on top from a soft pole draw here last week and ran well, just unable to sprint down the winner in a solid last half. This is a big drop in quality from what he faced last week and, now fitter fourth-up, he should be primed to put his best foot forward. You get the leading driver to navigate a sticky draw and give him every chance to be too strong for his rivals late in what looks a very suitable race. JUST PEDRO (8) looks to get the cosy run behind the likely leader here and conserve for one run late. He was a good winner last time at Ballarat and isn’t disadvantaged here being an ODM runner. OUR PINUP GIRL (6) was disappointing last week, but she was first-up and the market suggested she may need the outing. The stable goes well at this track and she’s worth another chance. BONA KHAN (1) will look to lead here, as he so often likes to do from these draws, and has been going okay. He just prefers the shorter distances, and seeing out this trip strongly is the concern. ILLAWONG PHOENIX (7) is going okay for the new stable but has a tricky draw to overcome and, although he will need luck, has solid claims at the minor end. BACK: MASTER LOUEY (5)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: MASTER LOUEY (5), JUST PEDRO (8), OUR PINUP GIRL (6), ILLAWONG PHOENIX (7)

OVERVIEW: LE GASTON (3) based on his SP profile alone, will start a short-priced favourite here, and on the strength of his first-up victory he deserves to head the market. He has overall been costly to punters, didn’t win by much at Kilmore, and the time wasn’t overly flash. He has a stable and driver in form and strikes a winnable race here. He’s not a “chips in” job at this stage, however. EAGLEYE (6) brings different form from NSW, where she was a last-start winner at Newcastle in decent time. More significantly, she joins a stable that has an excellent strike rate with horses new to the yard and often gets an upsurge in what they are able to produce. Watch the betting and include her in the Quaddie. MATRIARCH DAISY (5) is a 3yo filly who was in terrific form, but her last two runs have been well short of what she is capable of. She’s a go-forward type and her best form can win this, so keep her safe. STORM VENDETTA (4) was okay here last week in running second from a soft draw and is worth keeping safe again, as he should map okay. SELECTIONS: LE GASTON (3), EAGLEYE (6), MATRIARCH DAISY (5), STORM VENDETTA (4)

OVERVIEW:MAJESTIC CHARMA (8) finds a very suitable race with the mare’s allowance, being the sole runner off the back row and likely to map closer than she did last time out, when she rattled to the line in a slick closing section in a bigger and stronger field. She can tend to be a bit dicey at the start, but if she fills her action well, in this grade you can expect her to storm home late. JOU LOU (4) will no doubt be popular in the market on the back of winning four from six and developing a nice partnership with James Herbertson. He musters good gate speed and will look for the top end over the short trip, where he won last time. His times, however, haven’t been overly strong in weaker company, so although he ticks a lot of boxes, he does strike a better grade. BERTINELLI (7) is an interesting runner from NSW, where he hasn’t won in nearly a year but has been performing okay against largely Tuesday Menangle grade. He has a tricky draw to overcome but warrants respect. RIGHT OF REPLY (3) had every chance here and couldn’t sprint with them, but this does look a little more suitable and he should map well again. There are a number in the mix for the minor prize, including ATEGO DAWN (1), STEADY DREAM (2) and CARTALCHA (6). BACK: MAJESTIC CHARMA (8)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MAJESTIC CHARMA (8), JOU LOU (4), BERTINELLI (7), RIGHT OF REPLY (3)

OVERVIEW: UNCLE BILL (6) stands out here based on his maiden performance, where he showed good gate speed before taking cover and holding his ground against an above-average type who subsequently made the VICBRED Final. The exposed form of the others has been untrustworthy, so although you need to apply some caution with maiden trotters, this one is showing more positivity than the opposition. ALECTRONA (1) is getting closer to a win based on her past few performances and looks to map well here from the soft draw. Her times are comparable with the top pick and she can go close. ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (8) has a solid SP profile but came through the same race as the top pick last time out and galloped in running, although he was dropping out prior. He’s a great looker and can improve if the penny drops. CASUAL CONNECTION (4) is a NSW visitor from a strong stable who’s only had the one run, where she broke three times in running. She’s had plenty of trials, but the penny is yet to drop. She goes in merely out of respect for the stable, as she’s yet to command confidence based on performance. BACK: UNCLE BILL (6)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:UNCLE BILL (6), ALECTRONA (1), ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (8), CASUAL CONNECTION (4)

OVERVIEW: JILLIBY STRANGER (4) is a 2yo taking on older horses here, but he did so last time out when able to win his maiden at Terang after getting a perfect trip behind the leader. I’m not sure how strong that form is, but he will be better for the outing. It’s also unclear exactly how he maps here, but he will no doubt be popular in the market given the respect the stable commands in a race of this nature. CARUSO STAR (6) looks well suited as an 11-time winner, whereas many of the opposition have only won their maiden. He’s fitter now fourth-up and, more importantly, goes to the front row and has a draw to use his gate speed. He beat a better field two starts back here when mapping softly. QUICK CRUNCH (5) is a fast beginner and has been racing consistently overall this season. She was a winner five starts back when able to lead and control before just scraping home. Since then, she either hasn’t had the right draws or set-ups but has still been sound. She’s a winner at this track and, if she finds the top, will take running down. OPERTSER (1) was a winner two starts back, beating CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (7), with both driven to run on and performing well. They’ve both placed again since and must be given claims in a race with different form lines to assess. SELECTIONS:JILLIBY STRANGER (4), CARUSO STAR (6), QUICK CRUNCH (5), OPERTSER (1)

OVERVIEW: KEAYANG MARICRUZ (4) is a horse you will be able to get a strong line on, as she ran second to the top pick in the previous race last time at Terang, where she led and had every chance but was okay. If JILLIBY STRANGER happens to do the job in the previous race, her stocks will rise. Aside from that, the time she ran there may be good enough to get the job done this time, and with a smart stable behind her and tactical speed, she’s the starting point. RIDE HIGH CAPTAIN (2) is open to sharp improvement in his numerical form after a sound fifth here last week in a stronger race, and prior to that stuck on okay for second when sitting parked. He may map to get the right run and get his chance late. KING BALDWIN (6) has only had the one trial for the new stable, which was sound, and now makes his debut after plenty of experience at the trials in NSW. He’s hard to get a line on, but the trainer/driver combination warrants respect. MEGALODON (1) is another first starter who’s been at the Bacchus Marsh trials, which are inconclusive, but he is a market watch from the soft draw. SELECTIONS:KEAYANG MARICRUZ (4), RIDE HIGH CAPTAIN (2), KING BALDWIN (6), MEGALODON (1)

TWIN CONNECTION (1) was a winner by 7.9 metres last start at Globe Derby when he defeated PARISIAN BANDIT. He should find the lead from gate one tonight and lead all of the way. KEILAH (8) is well drawn and she should get a nice run into the race behind the leader from the second row. PARISIAN BANDIT (5) and TRIGGER (10) are also chances.

DHAULAGIRI (7) was extremely disappointing last start at Globe Derby but then he returned to the winners list five starts after that at Mildura. If he can repeat his Mildura form he should be hard to beat. LAST TANGO IN HEAVEN (1), HEZROCKINROYALTY (2) and OUR INDIFFERENCE (6) are also chances.

KETO (6) ran a very nice race first up behind HEEZ A VIBE last start. If he can get over and find the lead he will be very hard to beat. He is a strong chance after that impressive run last start. FLY THE BANNER (10), HEEZ A VIBE (7) and DEE JAYS MISS (5) are all big chances in what is a very even race.

HEZ SO ROYAL (3) has won two of his last three starts and he defeated IM ALL BUSINESS by 2.7 meters last start and attacked the line for a classy win. He looks extremely hard to beat tonight. LOCHINVAR LEADER (7) won’t like the draw but he stands out as a major chance in a race like this. NOTGUILTY (6) and B T CAPTIVATE (1) are also chances.

SOUTH AUSSIE STAR (8) returns from a few months off. She ran a handy trial here at Globe Derby recently. She will need some luck but she will be right in the finish if she gets a clear run. KOJAX (3) brings some strong NSW form into this race. It may pay to watch his market moves tonight. CECIL PEAK (4) and JADES REASON (1) are also chances.

HARRO HILL (7) was disappointing last start but her runs previous two starts were very impressive. If she can bring her best form tonight she will be very hard to beat. REACH THE PEAK (3) is first up from a spell. His form at Globe Derby last preparation was strong and he looks like a threat tonight despite not being seen at the trials. PER ARDUA AD ASTRA (1) will love the inside draw and is a big threat. TONKAWAIKON (6) is always a sneaky chance in a race like this.

VATICAN GREEN (6) finds his sort of race tonight. He either wins or runs towards the tail of the field. He can storm home and he is a major chance tonight. KITTYKAT CUTIE (2) finds an easier race tonight compared to her last two outings. She is well drawn and is a strong chance of leading all of the way but her last two runs are a minor concern. SPLASH OF PAYNT (8) and MISS OUT (11) are also chances.

CHILDERS ROAD (8) defeated MEET ME AT THE BEACH by 3 metres last start. He is a major chance tonight if he can get a clear run and he has a tremendous strike rate for Ryan Hryhorec. STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (1), ASHANTE PRINCE (7) and ALLORNOTHINGLEVI (10) are also chances.

AMIRA MARIE (6) ran second behind SPLASH OF PAYNT last start and she is showing sings of wanting to win again. She is a big chance tonight. PERFECT GAMBLE (2), TREACHEROUS ROCK (1) and LONESTAR WARRIOR (9) are also chances.

MAJESTIC SUMMER (2) will be a big danger off the front mark after an impressive last start win. She will be hard to beat if she steps away cleanly. REOFFENDER (8) has won three of his last five starts. He defeated HAYOAK by 6.6 meters. He will be a big threat tonight despite the tricky handicap. DAISY BOUCHEA (4) and CARLA PIXIE (7) are also chances. Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

WEE GEORGIE WOOD (2) has been a consistent performer and should be suited by the mile distance here. His chances would be enhanced significantly if SHEMEANSBUSINESS (1) decides to take a sit this week after disappointing when leading over the same distance last start, albeit in quick time. MERRYWOOD PAUL (6) gets into this race well with the claim and could be the improver if there is some genuine tempo throughout. The three Wayne Yole-trained runners, NATIONAL NEWS (3), CAN FEEL THE FURY (4) and JAMES CAGNEY (5), are likely to be saved for one run and will also be relying on some solid tempo throughout to allow them to finish over the top of the favoured runners. Selections:WEE GEORGIE WOOD (2), SHEMEANSBUSINESS (1), MERRYWOOD PAUL (6), NATIONAL NEWS (3)

A competitive No More Than Four Wins event, where Victorian visitor VIVID DREAM (7) brings some handy form to the state. She has undergone a stable change since her last start and may have to settle towards the rear of the field, but she looks the class horse of the race and may simply be too quick for them up the home straight with a nice run in transit. I GOTTA GO (3) broke through for a deserved victory last start after being unlucky on numerous occasions prior and should have enough gate speed to be first to the pegs here. There doesn't appear to be a lot of mid-race pressure unless ITZBUDDHA (4) grabs hold and pulls, so he should get every chance to finish on the podium. ROCKY STRIDE (5) drops back in grade after performing well in feature races of late and made good ground in a sharp mile last start. He possesses a very quick finishing burst when asked and looks a strong chance here. OUR WILLOW (6) is a four-year-old mare who clearly has plenty of ability when right. Her form has tapered off of late, but a change of scenery to a new stable may be the spark she needs to recapture her best. TAPPY (2) broke through for her first victory in the state last start, producing some nice closing sectionals to score. He should secure a nice run on speed with cover and gets every chance to finish on the podium again. Selections:VIVID DREAM (7), I GOTTA GO (3), ROCKY STRIDE (5), TAPPY (2)

IDEN OLIVER (2) has been quite dominant in his past two victories, recording good time over the middle distance, and again draws to get a nice run on speed here, gaining entry with the claim for driver Grace Jones. He may cop some early pressure from the Geoff Smith-prepared pair LIKEABLE ROGUE (3) and IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (6), but he should still get his chance to find a position on speed and be right in the finish. Both of those stablemates have been racing consistently of late and are due to break through for another victory, with their chances enhanced if either can find the pegs. KENYA (8) draws an awkward inside back-row gate but should appreciate some genuine tempo throughout and will be dangerous if the gaps come his way. JET TO HEAVEN (1) has broken at both starts since arriving in the state but could be right in the finish if he brings his best manners from the pole draw. TULLAH GIRL (4) uses the double claim to gain entry into this race and, if able to find a nice run in transit, should be running home strongly. Selections:IDEN OLIVER (2), LIKEABLE ROGUE (3), IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (6), KENYA (8)

The only full field of the night is for the maidens over the mile, where the talented but erratic SHIBASAKI (11) resumes from a break. He trialled nicely a month ago and has since undergone a stable change, and if he brings his best behaviour, he could take some holding out late. IDEN MISS WORLD (4) could be the improver, as I have her finding the pegs with her good gate speed. She also trialled nicely in handy time two weeks ago, and that form would see her right in the finish here. LIFE ONA HIGHWAY (9) is always thereabouts in races of this nature and should get a nice run through from the back-row draw to be running home strongly again. ARRIVAL TIME (8) draws an awkward gate but produced a handy enough performance first up in the state after doing some work, and should be in the finish if the gaps come his way. Selections:SHIBASAKI (11), IDEN MISS WORLD (4), LIFE ONA HIGHWAY (9), ARRIVAL TIME (8)

WEONA EAGLE (1) has returned to form over her past two starts and gets the handy draw to have options from the gate here. Expect INTO THE HARKNESS (2) and MUZZAME MATE (3) to push forward from their draws, while MY WAY (5) and LETSGOBRO (7) may also press forward with their good gate speed. That could set the race up nicely for the back-row runners WE SALUTE YOU (9) and MOVESLIKEALADY (10) to be finishing over the top. Both have been racing in good form of late and just need a nice run in transit to be strong winning chances here. JOHN VINCENT (6) would be expected to be driven with a sit and is another who could be finishing home strongly if he can get a nice cart into the race. Selections:WE SALUTE YOU (9), MOVESLIKEALADY (10), WEONA EAGLE (1), MUZZAMEMATE (3)

There looks to be a stack of speed here over the short-course distance, led by LYNRYD SKYNRYD (4) and WAVES OF CHANCE (6) from the middle front-row draws. WAVES OF CHANCE (6) clearly has plenty of ability and, if he can find the pegs and settle in running, could take plenty of running down. ANOTHER NIEN (8) should be a beneficiary of the hot speed throughout and, as the lone back-row runner following the scratching of the expected favourite, should be able to work into the running line and finish home strongly late. DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2) broke a long run of outs to score last start, hitting the line well, and looks set to receive another nice run on speed with cover here, giving him every chance to record back-to-back victories. Selections:ANOTHER NIEN (8), DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2), WAVES OF CHANCE (6), CENTURIAN MISS (1)

The Free For All is an intriguing race, with the speed map likely to depend on whether PARDOE PLUGGA (5) and WATERMELON SUGAR (6) use their brilliant gate speed to attempt to find the pegs first. BETTABLACK TIGER (2) was good first up for the new stable and expect he may be driven more conservatively here from the nice draw after being from the pole last start. He should take plenty of beating with clear running. CUSTOM HARLEY (4) would be expected to be put into the race at some stage and is always thereabouts in the finish in races of this nature, while GO THE RED (8) will be relying on some solid tempo up front to allow him to finish home strongly, as he has done numerous times of late since arriving in the state. Selections:BETTABLACK TIGER (2), CUSTOM HARLEY (4), GO THE RED (8), WATERMELON SUGAR (6)

The low-class race rounds out the night, where there looks to be a bit of speed engaged from the front row. KYRGIOS (1) makes his first start for the Brent Parish stable and looks to have sufficient gate speed to hold a forward position. His mainland form prior to arriving in Tasmania has to be respected in a race of this nature. DANCINWIVJOLENE (2) is also first up from a break and gets a nice draw to kick-start her campaign, having been super competitive in races of this grade previously. MIDNITE DESIRE (4) was well fancied in the market at both starts after arriving interstate but was only fair despite receiving nice runs in transit. He has since had a let-up, so an improved effort wouldn't surprise, although the market may be the best guide. OUR SWEET TRIXIE (5) is always earning cheques but strikes an awkward draw, as does CHRIS BE QUICK (9), who loves filling a placing in races of this nature. MODERN JIVE (8) resumes from a let-up and could be the one at odds if he can secure a soft run along the pegs and the gaps appear late. Selections:KYRGIOS (1), DANCINWIVJOLENE (2), MIDNITE DESIRE (4), MODERN JIVE (8) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: The big, bustling FIGHTER COMMAND (3) was arrogant when beating six rivals that reoppose here at Melton on August 22, and he’s the deserved favourite as he works towards a tilt at the Victoria Cup. He was first-up from a Queensland campaign that netted an Inter Dominion heat win and overcame a wide back row draw to win drawing away by 9.1m. It was a decisive triumph at free-for-all grade and he looks to be right at the top of his game. Good luck holding him out. BULLETPROOF BOY (10) was very good from the tail of the field in that same race but was then beaten as a short-priced favourite last time out when he found the front. He was a touch disappointing there, but he did fight back to run second despite looking in big strife at the corner. He’s an established star and will be rattling late over his favourite trip. MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (11) smoked home from three back the fence when a first-up third behind BULLETPROOF BOY (10) and long-odds winner TRIPLE EIGHT (6) there and should get a nice trail into this, while SMOKEN ACE (1) is favoured over a host of others for fourth spot given his good barrier draw. BACK: FIGHTER COMMAND (3) – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: FIGHTER COMMAND (3), BULLETPROOF BOY (10), MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (11), SMOKEN ACE (1)

OVERVIEW: An open final to start the night of Group 1 action where powerhouse trainer Emma Stewart has six runners in the race, including favourite ENJOY LIFE (2). He suffered the first defeat of his career at start nine in the semi-final last weekend, but was trapped parked and did a great job to run third. If he works to the top as expected, he’s the one to beat. That said, plenty can win including semi-final victors MOST EXCITING (1) and LE CARDINAL (3). MOST EXCITING (1) had this draw and sprint-laned past MAJOR BLITZ (8) to victory there, while LE CARDINAL (3) relished the hot tempo and unleashed his customary finishing burst to run over Luke McCarthy’s top-liner THE NITESHIFT (9), who was very good in defeat from the chair and won his heat at Kilmore prior from the front. CARDIGAN DAN (4) is another that can figure. He was an eye-catcher from near last with some incredible closing splits last weekend behind MOST EXCITING (1). Great race! SELECTIONS: ENJOY LIFE (2), MOST EXCITING (1), THE NITESHIFT (9), CARDIGAN DAN (4)

OVERVIEW:LAKE COMO (2) signalled his potential with a big finale to win on debut at Maryborough in early August and is yet to put in a bad run in four career starts. He heads into this Group 1 assignment on the back of a brilliant semi-final triumph where he rounded up his rivals from towards the back of the field to score. He’s exciting, progressive and from gate two – where he should land handy in the running line – I fancy he’s the one to beat. The scratching of semi-final winner CARDIGAN SNIPER (13) is significant, but his stablemate SOME HIGH (10) looks a key threat. He went past CARDIGAN SNIPER (13) last weekend before that rival fought back near the post to score. There was a huge gap back to third, which is always telling. SOHO BELLAGIO (4) was perhaps a shade disappointing when finding the top last weekend but might get the front again and can run well from there, while AUSTON (1) is drawn for a good trip on the fence and hasn’t been far behind LAKE COMO (2) his past two. BACK: LAKE COMO (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: LAKE COMO (2), SOME HIGH (10), SOHO BELLAGIO (4), AUSTON (1)

OVERVIEW: Speed aplenty off the front row here and a host of winning chances, with QUEEN OF SEES (1) my fancy from the good draw. Was happily against her in the heat last week, but she led, handed up and then sprint-landed to a soft victory over Aldebaran Ada and Gladiatrix, who did a huge job to run third after breaking at the start. Does she have the toe to hold a prominent spot? I think so – particularly after watching the way she rocketed out of the gate during a Vicbred heat in 2025 – but the level of early burn will be telling. HALLEBESOFINE (3) won the quickest of the three heats by a big margin and looks awfully hard to beat if she leads, and while JILLIBY AURA (10) won the other qualifier, the back row gate makes it hard for her. As mentioned, Group 1 winner GLADIATRIX (13) bombed the start in the heat, tacked on and went to the chair before only being beaten 6m into third. If the speed is on, she can win. Fellow Group 1 winner ADELAIDE RED (4) has great gate speed and looks the other key hope if she can get across to the fence. BACK: QUEEN OF SEES (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: QUEEN OF SEES (1), GLADIATRIX (13), HALLEBESOFINE (3), ADELAIDE RED (4)

OVERVIEW: Another wide-open Group 1 final where you can make a case for quite a few. In saying that, I’m keen on PASTOR DUNBAR (10) who has proven himself as the top seed of his three-year-old crop with a Group 1 NSW Trotters Derby triumph among six wins from seven starts in 2026. He was a little unflattering winning his heat, but the arrogant Holmfield triumph from the death seat against six rivals that reoppose here made me a real believer. He can make his own luck and is the one to beat. Fellow heat victor HOWDY MATE (6) looks a key threat and there’s a chance he might be able to work to the top. He’s grown into himself in recent starts and I really like the way he’s going. Last season’s star two-year-old KEAYANG BAZLENKA (9) led up the running line and made good ground from a mile back for fourth in his heat behind HOWDY MATE (6). He strips fitter here and a different race shape brings him into play. MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) was the other heat winner and is a nice type but the gate is awkward, while MISTER DEVEREAUX (13) led, handed up and took ground off PASTOR DUNBAR (10) last Friday and is really progressing nicely for Team Brosnan. One to consider at odds. BACK: PASTOR DUNBAR (10) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: PASTOR DUNBAR (10), KEAYANG BAZLENKA (9), HOWDY MATE (6), MISTER DEVEREAUX (13)

OVERVIEW: VERBICI (9) is an unbeaten star two-year-old trotter who extended his record to six wins from six starts with an easy front-running victory in a qualifier at Melton last weekend and is the clear horse to beat. He’s professional and has the point-to-point speed to round up his rivals from the back row draw. He really should be winning barring any bad luck given the key scratching of PHOENIX REX (1), who looked his key danger. REGAL GALA (7) chased him home for second last week and just keeps improving as the season wears on. He has the gate speed to cross and race up top. PHOENIX REX (1) was beaten for the first time in his career when run down in the other heat by INSULATOR (5), who galloped down the back straight but incredibly picked himself up to score. He’s always shaped as a nice horse, but manners are the worry with him. That’s quite possibly your top three with KYVALLEY DIABLO (8) maybe the pick for fourth, but nothing would surprise for that position. SELECTIONS: VERBICI (9), REGAL GALA (7), INSULATOR (5), KYVALLEY DIABLO (8)

OVERVIEW: Looks a genuine match race here between heat and semi-final winners KAHULA (5) and IDEAL FRANKIE (12). Both have claimed big feature races already this season and are looking for Group 1 glory to cap their outstanding two-year-old campaigns. The barrier draw was crucial, and given the front row advantage to KAHULA (5), she’s likely to work forward and find the front. She’s narrowly favoured, but don’t be surprised if IDEAL FRANKIE (12) is good enough to run her down. They look the quinella. Outside those, LA CANTATRICE (9) has been a whole lot of fun for the Ballarat & District Trotting Club Standardbred Group this campaign with three wins and a good closing second to KAHULA (5) in the semi-final, while DECOUPAGE (2) showed electric gate speed in the heat and might be able to find the top and hand up to KAHULA (5). Another at odds worth considering on a place line is HEAVENLY GEM (10), who was trapped parked and did a massive job to still run second behind IDEAL FRANKIE (12) last weekend. SELECTIONS: KAHULA (5), IDEAL FRANKIE (12), LA CANTATRICE (9), DECOUPAGE (2)

OVERVIEW: BUMPER CROP (2) is unbeaten in four career starts and looks the testing material in this final for two-year-old trotting girls. She sat parked for the last lap in her heat and won effortlessly over KYVALLEY DIXON (13), and the barrier two draw means she will likely work forward and control things at the top. Hard to beat and the deserved favourite. MAJARO GIRL (12) has improved sharply since joining the Andy Gath barn and a brilliant Kate Gath drive managed to get her home in the other qualifier over LOLLY (10), who has run two good runner-up placings this campaign and is an exciting trotter for trainer Bill Milner. MISS MUSCLE (11) has been very consistent in five career outings and will run well, while fast starter ZIPPIN PAST (4) might be another to add to those names for trifectas and First 4s. SELECTIONS: BUMPER CROP (2), MAJARO GIRL (12), LOLLY (10), MISS MUSCLE (11)

OVERVIEW:BETTOR BEACH (1) looks to have a mortgage on this Vicbred final for three-year-old fillies after two dynamic heat and semi-final victories. She led and darted clear to score by a big space at Kilmore before landing in the one-one and dashing away to prevail by a similar space at Melton last weekend. Would be shocked if she was beaten. The in-form SWEET IRISH LOCH (5) won the other qualifier over RACHELS LEGACY (4), who was held up and unlucky there. They’re leading dangers, particularly RACHELS LEGACY (4) if she can spear across to the pegs early. PRE EMINANT (9) finished second in the two-year-old Vicbred final last season and has been good in both the heats and semi-finals of this series, but it’s hard to see her overturning the result on her stablemate in this Group 1 showdown. SELECTIONS: BETTOR BEACH (1), RACHELS LEGACY (4), PRE EMINANT (9), KEAYANG PASSION (8) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R1 #3 FIGHTER COMMAND – 4 units (win) R3 #2 LAKE COMO – 2 units (win) R4 #1 QUEEN OF SEES – 2 units (win) R5 #10 PASTOR DUNBAR – 2 units (win) EARLY QUADDIE 3,10,11/1,2,3,4,9/1,2,4,10/1,3,4,10,13 QUADDIE 6,9,10/9/5/2 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

ULTRA AIR PACE HUNGRY HIPPO (6) is a newcomer to the Seaton Grima yard and brings an impressive strike rate. Readied with a couple of trials and won his lone attempt at this distance so can make an immediate impact. ERUPT STRIDE (3) copped a flat tyre and pulled up lame when a beaten favourite last start so it may pay to be forgiving. Draws well so worth another chance. ROCKNROLL HAMMER (7) has been racing well from similar barriers, winning over this distance two back before a solid second last week. Player again. ALTA SIERRA (9) will find this easier than the last attempt and was going well prior while IM ROCKIN IT (8) draws wider but did a good job in winning at this circuit and distance last start.

BESTINBEDS.COM.AU PACE HUXTON (5) has performed well from wider barriers in his two attempts at this circuit and distance since joining Jason Grimson, placing after racing parked two back then working to the front before going on to score by 3.3m last time. Up in grade but looks capable of taking that step. FARFALLA STRIDE (2) hasn't raced since a second in a mares' race here in May but draws well and should be ready to go off two nice trials, winning the latest. MIKE ROSS (7) has been quite consistent of late and could measure up if things go his way. RAVISHING SLOY (10) cops the outside barrier but his best form would measure up in a race like this.

MICHAEL HEHIR'S 80TH BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION CAROUSEL HEAT 1 LEXUS LOU (2) impressed in his first outing for Jason Grimson here last week, leading from a wider barrier than this before drawing clear to spank his rivals by close to 35m. Jumps in grade but has the speed to take advantage of the low draw. WICKED WIZARD (8) led and kept going to get home by just over a metre here last start. Draws wider but came from a similar barrier to win in his lone attempt at this distance last month. VAN BASTEN (9) draws wide but his recent consistency at this venue is hard to knock, placing in all three starts since a win last month. There was merit in last week's performance of SWEET STRIKE (7) from a wider draw and he had been racing consistently prior so is worth including.

PRYDE'S EASIFEED CAROUSEL HEAT 2 Smart three-year-old PALLADIUM (8) makes his first appearance since his fighting win in the Queensland Derby in July. Draws wide but has been readied for his return with a trial win. Has plenty of upside and this looks highly winnable. BUZZ BOMB (9) draws wider than in last week's solid effort but he did well to finish fifth from this barrier in the August Gift Final prior and was a winner here last month. MICK DANGER (5) has been ticking along okay, clocking in third from this barrier here last time for his third placing in his last five starts. Worth including along with JILLIBY FABIO (10) who draws wide but has been coming from the back row in higher-graded races of late and placed the last time he raced here.

GARRARDS HORSE AND HOUND CAROUSEL HEAT 3 NYMBAL (5) continues to race well having placed in both outings since he led for a win at this venue last month. Had strong form against the good three-year-olds over the Brisbane carnival, highlighted by a Redcliffe Derby win and Queensland Derby fourth. He looks suited up to a distance where he won his lone attempt. TOMAHAWK BART (7) has been racing well in higher-graded races including a Penrith win two back. Draws wide but has the early speed to be prominent. NOVANTA RISING (9) found winning form two back at Wagga before coming from the back line to miss narrowly last start at Goulburn. Draws wide but he is going well. JANIE BLU (6) draws wider than in the last-start second but that was her third placing here on the trot and she is two-time winner at this longer distance. MAURLEN BOY (4) didn't miss by much here last week and draws lower.

CLUB MENANGLE SUTTON MCMILLAN FFA (LISTED CLASSIC) CAPTAINS KNOCK (5) stretched his winning streak to four when he came from wider to score by 9m here last week. Cruised home by 14m over this longer trip prior, taking his record at the distance to 50 per cent. He has the early speed to take full advantage of a lower draw so is hard to tip against. NYACK (3) makes his first appearance since he placed in all three rounds of the Inter Dominion series in Brisbane in July, finishing third to the elite duo of Captains Mistress and Leap To Fame in the final. Has had eight weeks off since but has trialled in that time and draws well. MAX DELIGHT (7) and JORGE STREET (4) are both musts for exotic players having placed behind Captains Knock last week.

IRT HORSE TRANSPORT LADYSHIP PACE POPS JOY (8) is a progressive mare who put the writing on the wall with back-to-back placings before digging deep to get home at this circuit and distance last start. Draws a couple of spots wider but she is going well enough to overcome that. WEONA MISS MIKI (10) was far from disgraced when fifth against the good mares at Listed level last week. Beat Pops Joy when she won here prior and while she draws much wider than she did there she'll enjoy the class drop on last week's attempt. SHEZ SWEET LOUISE (9) is another drawn out but she is suited back against the mares after going under narrowly last start at Bathurst. DAVOLAS LEGACY (6) deserves respect after racing parked but sticking on to place behind Pops Joy last start.

LIVAMOL TROTTERS MOBILE CORMORAN STRIKE (6) is hard to knock having made it four wins and a placing from his last five starts here when he came from this same barrier to score by 2.3m last time. Drops back to the mile but has won his last two attempts at the distance. Looks tough to beat again. GANDHI MAIL ITA (8) has chased Cormoran Strike in both outings since winning his local debut but he had little luck two back before leading from this barrier last start and sticking on for second. He can give a sight again. PESCO POLLO (7) disappointed last time but had scored twice in a row prior. Has won five of eight tries at the mile so the distance drop should suit. RAKERO BLAZE (10) hasn't raced since July's Inter Dominion series where she struggled with her manners but she has been readied for her return with a trial win.

BRAVO FOODS 3YO PACE ETHANS REVENGE (4) couldn't match the flying Loucasso last week but had been good from tricky draws in his other two starts this time in, winning from the back row when fresh at Penrith before a close second here. Comes up against an easier bunch this week and should get his chance from this draw. LOCHINVAR MARCELLO (7) was just in front of Ethans Revenge when fourth last week. A wide draw makes his task tougher but he has been going well, winning three back at this circuit and distance. AGENTOFGOODINTENT (3) raced parked but was too strong at Penrith last start. Led from wider than this when he won at this circuit and distance in July so can take advantage of the good draw. DUTTON (1) rises in grade but he toughed out a win after working here last start and should get the favours from the inside draw. BEST BETS:
